literal_meaning: এক (one) + হারা (type or build, possibly from 'হার' meaning row or line, implying uniform slender form)
figurative_meaning_en: A particular type of physique or slender build
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার একহারা চেহারা দেখলে মনে হয় সে খুব লম্বা এবং পাতলা।
একহারা লোকেরা সাধারণত দৌড়ে ভালো করে।
example_sentences_in_english: His lanky build makes him look very tall and thin.
People with a slender physique usually excel in running.
note: Refers to a slim, elongated body structure in everyday Bengali speech
